documents.title: Callback acknowledgement and receiver processing v1
documents.content: Protocol v1. A callback FAILED with actual receiver HTTP 503 is a transport failure. ACKNOWLEDGED with HTTP 202 means only accepted into the receiver queue. Verify the same event receiver processing state; QUEUED is not PROCESSED. Never resend automatically.

documents.title: Order lifecycle and callback trigger v1
documents.content: Protocol v1. HTTP 200 on an order read means the request succeeded, not that the order completed. Callback is emitted only after COMPLETED. A PROCESSING order does not prove a callback failure. Query current order state before drawing a root cause. Use the same bound order version when correlating its callback event.

documents.title: Callback failure and retry policy v1
documents.content: Protocol v1 retry contract. A 503 response with TEMPORARY_UNAVAILABLE is retriable. Retry state SCHEDULED and a trusted retry_at mean the sender will make another attempt; wait for that attempt rather than creating a parallel resend. Contact the callback operator only when the attempt limit is reached and the trusted retry state is EXHAUSTED. Correlate response request, event, order and attempt count.
